title: Rawlings Leather Baseball Softball Glove RBG 36 TT 12 1/2" RHT Basket Web
descriptionText:
Used. See pics. 

This Rawlings baseball softball glove is perfect for any player looking for a reliable and high-quality option. With a brown color and leather material, this glove is built to last and perform at any level of play. The basket web design and 5 finger style provide maximum comfort and support, while the right-handedness makes it perfect for all positions on the field.

Measuring at 12.5 inches and made in Vietnam, this intermediate-level glove is suitable for both baseball and softball. The lining material is also made of leather, ensuring durability and comfort. Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, this Rawlings glove is a great choice.
